accounting.pacing: bounded pacing DEBIT — TokenBucket::debit(size); every later refill repays debt before granting tokens

bounds: at most one permit per DupRec.id
cancel_on: ACK progress (inflight shrank) clears the slot and the granted-id memory
consume: immediately, exactly one TransmitKind::Duplicate for that DupRec, same call

eligible_recovery_class.grounding: sender.rs drain_new_data pushes DupRec on every PreConverge DATA wire-emit; pending_lost stays empty in PreConverge (loss declaration gated in on_ack_received and on_timer); tail probe absent in the shipped tail-OFF default

no_second_permit_for_same_due: mint keyed on DupRec.id + bounded granted-set (defence against poll inflation)
preflight_verdict: Durum A — starvation present in P0 shipped baseline (tail OFF)
structural_exclusion: permit reachable only inside drain_due_duplicates; drain_new_data and plan_fec_parity have no call path to the mint
unique_mint_event: first time a specific DupRec is due AND refused by the normal pacer
work_item_invalidation: DupRec removed (unit ACKed / epoch change) -> slot cleared, no emission
